premises.text: Large companies contract with suppliers for everything yet have almost no information on supplier environmental sustainability
premises.evidence_span: they don't have almost any information on their supplier's environmental sustainability

premises.text: Consumers, shareholders, and media increasingly scrutinize supply-chain sustainability
premises.evidence_span: Consumers, shareholders, and the media are increasingly paying attention to supply chain sustainability problems

premises.text: The first truly integrated platform lets companies understand and manage sustainability, evaluate risk, and drive supplier improvement
premises.evidence_span: We've developed the first truly integrated platform that helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better.

premises.text: On-the-fly drill-down analysis re-weights issues and identifies which suppliers are part of a given problem
premises.evidence_span: This is supply chain analysis, supply chain risk analysis on the fly.

premises.text: Supplier dashboards with industry-peer benchmarking incentivize suppliers to improve
premises.evidence_span: Now, Spacely Sprockets can see where it stands relative to its industry peers, and that's a game changer.

premises.text: Anonymous cross-network score visibility gives buyers access to more sustainable suppliers, who then win more business
premises.evidence_span: you can also see the anonymous scores of suppliers outside of your supply chain. So now buyers have access to more sustainable suppliers, and more sustainable suppliers get more business.

premises.text: A unified scorecard library fixes RFP fatigue: companies reuse common questionnaires and suppliers answer once
premises.evidence_span: we have a unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: The platform charges an annual fee plus a small per-supplier fee
premises.evidence_span: they pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

value.text: Companies understand and manage supply-chain sustainability and risk instead of flying blind into scandals
value.evidence_span: helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better

secondary_value.text: More sustainable products for the companies' own customers
secondary_value.evidence_span: the part that will make the products that you buy more sustainable

causal_links.evidence_span: it will be incentivized to improve because maintaining good relationships with buyers is so critical
companies have very little information and are flying blind
understand which of its suppliers are actually part of the problem
more sustainable suppliers get more business
